statement: For every prime p congruent to3 modulo4, the actual degree-p^3 exponent-p Heisenberg cover z^p=psi_p(x) of the punctured Gaussian elliptic curve, of genus1+p^2(p-1)/2 and p^2 cusps, satisfies both TaskA.5 assertions at every coefficient prime and every permitted cusp packet.
answers: Task A.5: both assertions for an unbounded family of actual nilpotent covers, uniformly in every inert prime p
notes: Registered after complete independent root, DE and PBC proof/source audits and exact reruns PASS. The proof is uniform for every p congruent to3 modulo4. The divided operator E=D^p/p modp identifies the actual derivative Dh=R^p with DR=a in F_p^times, and Frobenius roots A,S satisfy DS=RA/a. This kills every hidden degree-p Taylor term. Actual smooth main and tail charts yield one supersingular elliptic component and p genus-p(p-1)/2 Artin--Schreier tails. The genus sum forces compact type. All p^2 cusps lie on a rational marked tree overO. A41--42 give full fixed inertia for every coefficient prime and packet; A59 gives all normalizers using the actual exponent-p Heisenberg deck group. Certificates at p=3,7,11,19 support the uniform proof and do not replace it. Universal TaskA.5 remains Open; no cofinality or general nilpotent fixed-group theorem is asserted.
